title: Russia Imposes Plague Quarantine After Laboratory Worker's Death
detail: Russian authorities imposed a plague quarantine following a laboratory worker's death, escalating concern beyond the earlier suspected Siberia case and raising biosafety questions. The Kremlin continues to downplay the risk despite the confirmed fatality and formal quarantine measures.

media.caption: Russian authorities impose plague quarantine following lab worker's death in Siberia

title: Suspected Bubonic Plague Case Reported in Siberia Amid Kremlin Downplaying
detail: A suspected case of bubonic plague has been reported in Siberia, with Kremlin reassurances failing to quell growing public concern. Authorities have attempted to downplay the incident but anxiety among the population continues to rise as details remain limited.
